sources.title: Voxtral release announcement, July 15, 2025
sources.evidence: Announces both original Voxtral sizes on July 15, 2025 under Apache 2.0 with downloadable weights, 32k context, multilingual speech understanding and native function calling from voice.

sources.title: Voxtral Small 1.0 (24B) - 2507 model card
sources.evidence: Names the exact July 2025 checkpoint; documents transcription, translation, audio understanding, text capability, eight named languages, 32k context and experimental function calling with an audio-input example.

sources.title: Voxtral technical report, Table 1 and sections 1–2
sources.evidence: Table 1 gives Small 24.3B total: 640M audio encoder, 52M adapter, 670M text embeddings and 22.9B language decoder. Sections 1–2 describe native audio function calling, text/audio inputs, text output and the encoder-adapter-decoder Transformer.

sources.title: Voxtral Small native configuration
sources.evidence: Native params specify max_position_embeddings=32768; a 40-layer language decoder (dim 5120, hidden_dim 32768, 32 attention and 8 KV heads), 32-layer Whisper encoder and 4x audio downsampling.

sources.title: Voxtral Small Transformers conversion configuration
sources.evidence: The converted VoxtralForConditionalGeneration config contains a llama text model and voxtral_encoder audio model. Its text_config.max_position_embeddings=131072 conflicts with native params.json and the advertised 32k support.

sources.title: Official Voxtral Small 25.07 documentation source
sources.evidence: Exact checkpoint row links Voxtral-Small-24B-2507 and explicitly reports parameters 24, active 24, Apache 2.0, 32k context, July 15, 2025 release, audio/text inputs, text output and function-calling. Feature enumeration supplies no explicit negative reasoning classification.

sources.title: Official model weights table renderer
sources.evidence: Maps the parameters and active fields to the separate Parameters (B) and Active (B) column headers, establishing units and the meaning of the exact model row.

sources.title: Native Voxtral Small checkpoint tensor header
sources.evidence: Read only HTTP 206 byte ranges 0–7 and 8–115751. All 851 entries are BF16 weight/bias tensors: 40 decoder layers each have single w1/w2/w3 feed-forward blocks; 32 audio encoder layers have single w1/w2 blocks; no expert/router tensors. Tensor shapes total 24,259,880,960 elements, comprising learned matrix, bias and normalization tensors without quantization scales, packed storage or positional buffers.

name.note: Catalog rendering of the exact Voxtral Small 1.0 (24B) - 2507 name and checkpoint identifier.

developer.note: First-party announcement and mistralai checkpoint identify Mistral AI as developer; retain existing short name.

family.note: The original July 2025 Voxtral Small release belongs to the Voxtral family.

release_date.note: Announcement date and exact-version documentation releaseDate agree; this precedes the July 17 technical-report publication.

open_weights.note: Official announcement offers downloadable weights; the public exact-checkpoint native tensor header was accessed.

license.note: The exact model card and official weights row identify Apache 2.0.

parameters_b.note: Use Table 1 complete-checkpoint total, rounded to 0.1B: audio encoder 0.640B, adapter 0.052B, text embeddings 0.670B and language decoder 22.9B. Independently read native header shapes total 24.259880960B, consistent with 24.3B; component values in the report are rounded. The docs/name round total to 24B.

active_parameters_b.note: The exact first-party weights row explicitly publishes Active (B)=24. Preserve this nominal figure independently of the more precise complete total; do not infer equality from dense architecture. No finer or audio/text-phase-specific active count is supplied.

architecture.note: Verified from native structure, not merely the Transformer label: all 40 decoder layers have one w1/w2/w3 FFN, all 32 encoder layers one w1/w2 FFN, with attention blocks and a two-matrix audio adapter; no expert bank or router. Official configs agree with this dense audio-language structure.

context_window.note: Native params explicitly set 32768, matching documented 32k support. Converted config carries 131072, recorded as a conversion discrepancy rather than evidence of supported 128k context. The 30/40-minute task limits and encoder max_source_positions=1500 are not total token context.

modalities.note: Exact official capability record and examples establish text/audio input and text output; no audio-generation output is asserted.

reasoning.note: Sources describe general audio/text reasoning ability and instruction tuning, but do not explicitly classify this exact checkpoint as supporting or lacking a dedicated reasoning mode. Absence from a feature enum does not verify false; clear the baseline assertion.

tool_call.note: Native function calling from voice is explicit, including an exact-checkpoint tool-call example; the model-card example labels support experimental.

description.value: Open audio-language model for speech transcription, audio understanding, and voice-driven tool use
description.note: Existing description accurately summarizes the released checkpoint and its documented capabilities without unsupported performance claims.

patch.notes: Technical report Table 1 reports a complete 24.3B checkpoint (rounded); its independently rounded components are 0.640B audio encoder, 0.052B adapter, 0.670B text embeddings and 22.9B language decoder. Native BF16 header shapes total 24.259880960B. The official documentation independently labels 24B active, a nominal figure without modality-phase detail. Retain native/documented 32,768-token context despite the converted Transformers config listing 131,072. Function calling is native; the model card calls its example experimental. Dedicated reasoning-mode classification remains unverified.

summary: Correct total parameters from nominal 24B to the technical report’s complete 24.3B; independently verify the official 24B active label and dense native architecture. Preserve July 15 release, Apache 2.0, 32,768 native/documented context, text/audio-to-text modalities and native tool calls. Clear unsupported reasoning=false to null/unverified; record the converted-config context discrepancy and rounded component counts.
